root.label: Center report projects New York City universal child care cost

events.label: Center report projects New York City universal child care cost

slots.name: average child cost
slots.sentence: with an average cost per child of around $27,000.

slots.name: spending gap
slots.sentence: That’s about $5 billion more than the city spent on child care in 2025.

slots.name: new workers needed
slots.sentence: The roughly $3 billion gap between Mr. Mamdani’s estimate and the center’s projection is largely attributable to teacher pay.

slots.name: median pay hourly
slots.sentence: Child care providers in family care centers — small programs run out of private homes — have a median take home pay of just $6 an hour, according to a separate report by the center.

slots.name: new seats needed
slots.sentence: The researchers projected that the Mamdani administration would need to create about 10,000 new seats to accommodate the infants and toddlers who are too young to enroll in pre-K right now.

slots.name: state funding amount
slots.sentence: Gov. Kathy Hochul has given the Mamdani administration $1.2 billion to jump-start its program for 2-year-olds in some neighborhoods.
